summary: Sibling of Carmela 'Mollie' Gianetta; John's great-grand-uncle/aunt.
bio:
Listed among Mollie's siblings in the FS tree (Savino 1897-1964, Mariano Martin 1899-1941, Maria 1902, Antonio 1907-1998, Giuseppe 1912-1971, Rosa 1914, Charles J. 1916-1975). The family lived in Dunmore (Ward 5) 1910-30.

Maria came from Bisaccia with her mother about 1909 (she is 'Marie', 8, in the 1910 census) and married Joseph Pichiarello, an Italian-born grocer ([R4-S2], [R4-S1]). In April 1950 the Pichiarellos lived on Sand Street in Dunmore, next door to her sister Mollie Petriello's family. Joseph was proprietor of a retail grocery store, their son James worked in it as a sales clerk, and their married daughter Angelica and her husband Anthony Marciano lived with them ([R4-S1]).
sources: [R4-S1] 1950 US census, Dunmore borough, Lackawanna Co., PA, ED 35-115, sheet 10 (21 Apr 1950), Sand Street: James Petriello household (no. 128) and Joseph Pichiarello household next door.
